name: THIS ISNT REAL
source:
Is fate supposed to be followed? Should you leave it up to the stars even if you know it will end in tragedy? Play as Cath, the caretaker of the oracle, as the clock towards the ritual ticks down.

[From [url=https://ameae.itch.io/this-isnt-real]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
命运当真只能顺从吗？哪怕明知结局注定是一场悲剧，你也该将一切交由星辰定夺吗？在仪式倒计时滴答逼近之际，扮演神谕者的看护人凯丝（Cath）做出抉择吧。

[摘自[url=https://ameae.itch.io/this-isnt-real]itch.io[/url]]
